author: richburdon
principle: Don't add a type-specific concept that duplicates an existing cross-cutting feature of the ontology (e.g. a Label field when Tags already exist); integrate with the shared mechanism instead.
fix_shape: drop the custom field and route the concept through the existing cross-cutting mechanism.

author: richburdon
principle: Track an external system's identifier for an ECHO object using the object's built-in meta.foreignKeys, not a custom ad hoc field.
fix_shape: remove the custom external-id field and store it via Obj.Meta foreignKeys instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Never cast to `as any` to silence a type error; fix the underlying type instead.
fix_shape: resolve the actual type mismatch instead of casting to any.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Build the value via the existing factory function instead of casting to any to fake compatibility.
fix_shape: call the existing `make` factory rather than constructing the object and casting it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give a resource type that narrows Effect requirements (like a toolkit) a `provide` function with dual (data-first/data-last) signatures, consistent with Effect's own Layer.provide.
fix_shape: add a Function.dual-style provide implementation that narrows the requirement type the same way Layer.provide does.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't erase a generic requirements type parameter to `any`; propagate it outward into the effect's own requirement type.
fix_shape: make the API generic over R and thread that generic through the returned effect's type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't erase a generic requirements type parameter to `any`; propagate it outward into the effect's own requirement type.
fix_shape: change the parameter type to keep the requirements generic instead of widening it to any.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Be explicit and correct with a generic type's parameters at each call site rather than defaulting them away.
fix_shape: specify the concrete type parameters (e.g. <never, any>) on the return type instead of leaving them implicit.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't manually reconstruct/denormalize a value from its parts when the API can derive or provide it directly.
fix_shape: use the API's direct construction path instead of assembling the value from separate pieces.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When implementing a Layer.provide-like requirement-narrowing function, compute the resulting requirement type with the standard Exclude<R, R0> | R2 formula rather than a bespoke one.
fix_shape: correct the type signature to use Exclude<R, R0> | R2.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't erase a generic requirements type parameter to `any`; propagate it outward into the effect's own requirement type.
fix_shape: add the generic <R> parameter and use the typed toolkit signature instead of `any`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't erase a generic requirements type parameter to `any`; propagate it outward into the effect's own requirement type.
fix_shape: add the generic <R> parameter and use the typed toolkit signature instead of `any`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Register a resource's cleanup (e.g. an interval or subscription) through the framework's lifecycle mechanism instead of leaving it running with no teardown.
fix_shape: wrap the created resource's cleanup in a destructor registered via the framework's contribution API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose invocable business logic as the framework's standard Operations mechanism rather than as plain internal functions called ad hoc.
fix_shape: wrap the functions as Operation definitions instead of calling them directly from the capability module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a new type's field represents an existing domain entity, add an optional Ref to the standard shared type instead of duplicating its fields inline.
fix_shape: add a Ref to the canonical shared type alongside (or instead of) the ad hoc inline fields.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a new type's field represents an existing domain entity, add an optional Ref to the standard shared type instead of duplicating its fields inline.
fix_shape: check for an existing standard type (e.g. a calendar event type) and reference it instead of defining a new plugin-specific one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the existing helper function for reading an object's foreignKeys instead of manually destructuring the meta object.
fix_shape: replace the manual meta lookup with the existing Obj.getKeys call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Route calls to a language model through the shared AI-service/operation mechanism instead of making a custom API call with its own credentials.
fix_shape: convert the ad hoc AI call into an operation using the shared AiService rather than a direct API token.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When introducing a mechanism meant to be independent of an existing one, remove the overlapping wiring to the old mechanism rather than leaving both partially connected.
fix_shape: remove the crossover wiring so the new mechanism stands alone from the old one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define a reusable spec/constant at module level rather than inside a function scope when nothing requires it to be local, and name it consistently with sibling specs.
fix_shape: hoist the definition to module scope and rename it to match the established naming pattern.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a required piece of context is missing, fail hard (invariant/throw) rather than silently falling back to a degraded no-op.
fix_shape: replace the silent fallback with an invariant/throw.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a required piece of context is missing, fail hard (invariant/throw) rather than silently falling back to a degraded no-op.
fix_shape: apply a hard error uniformly across every spec of that kind that lacks the required context.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Mark a module intended to be imported as a namespace with the project's namespace-export directive comment.
fix_shape: add the namespace-export directive comment above the module's exports.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Re-export a module as a namespace in a package's barrel rather than a named re-export of its individual members.
fix_shape: change the named re-export to a namespace re-export (export * as X from).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Declare a spec's own required capabilities locally rather than relying on an ambient/closed-over dependency, and define it at module top-level rather than nested inside a function.
fix_shape: add explicit requires to the spec and hoist its definition to module scope.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Compute a value unconditionally and let the consumer decide whether to use it, rather than branching earlier to avoid constructing it.
fix_shape: remove the outer conditional and pass the value through always, gating its use downstream instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the `const` type-parameter modifier for a generic that should infer a literal type rather than widening it.
fix_shape: add the const modifier to the generic parameter.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Combine tightly related layer specs for the same scoped resource into a single spec instead of several parallel ones.
fix_shape: merge the separate specs into one combined spec.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Merge multiple layers together and provide them in a single Effect.provide call instead of chaining several Effect.provide calls.
fix_shape: combine the layers with Layer.mergeAll/Layer.provideMerge and call Effect.provide once.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add defensive fallback/optional-chaining for a value that the contract already guarantees is present; trust it.
fix_shape: remove the defensive fallback and use the value directly.

author: richburdon
principle: Render a plugin-contributed piece of UI through the framework's Surface mechanism rather than embedding a specific component directly.
fix_shape: replace the direct component usage with the appropriate Surface component.

author: richburdon
principle: Show a dialog through the app's existing dialog-invocation pattern rather than rendering a local Dialog.Root ad hoc.
fix_shape: switch to the established dialog-showing mechanism used elsewhere in the app.

author: richburdon
principle: Define a component's Props type in the same file, next to the component, rather than elsewhere.
fix_shape: move the Props type declaration to sit beside its component.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't hardcode default content (blueprints, operations) into a shared test harness; everything must be contributed through the plugin system, consistent with how the real app is composed.
fix_shape: remove the built-in defaults and require callers to supply them via plugins.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Drive an end-to-end test through the real operation the production code invokes, not a parallel test-only layer that reimplements the flow.
fix_shape: fire the actual production operation inside the test harness instead of using a bespoke test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add new query-behavior logic to the existing query-source class hierarchy rather than layering a decorator/mixin over query results.
fix_shape: move the validation logic into the existing query-source subclasses instead of wrapping results in a new decorator class.
